# ui::StrokeStyle

Header: `winui/render/Renderer.hpp`.

A [Shape](../controls/shapes.md#uishape)'s stroke settings with their defaults. `dash_array` and `dash_offset` are in multiples of `thickness`. An empty array is a solid line.

Example: 
```cpp
auto line = std::make_unique<ui::LineControl>();
line->set_stroke(ui::colors::Black);
line->set_stroke_style(ui::StrokeStyle{
    .start_cap  = ui::PenLineCap::Round,
    .end_cap    = ui::PenLineCap::Round,
    .dash_array = {2.0f, 1.0f}, // 2x thickness on, 1x off
});
line->set_stroke_thickness(4.0f); // thickness is owned by this setter
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thickness` | `float` | `1.0f` | Pen width in DIPs. |
| `start_cap` | `PenLineCap` | `PenLineCap::Flat` | Cap at a figure's first point. |
| `end_cap` | `PenLineCap` | `PenLineCap::Flat` | Cap at a figure's last point. |
| `dash_cap` | `PenLineCap` | `PenLineCap::Flat` | Cap at both ends of every dash. |
| `line_join` | `PenLineJoin` | `PenLineJoin::Miter` | How corners are joined. |
| `miter_limit` | `float` | `10.0f` | Miter length cap, in half-thicknesses. |
| `dash_array` | `std::vector<float>` |  | On/off lengths in thicknesses; empty is solid. |
| `dash_offset` | `float` | `0.0f` | Start phase in the dash pattern, in thicknesses. |
